help.stdout:
usage: gnd import mined-rules [-h] --population POPULATION --reported REPORTED
                              --target {amie} --out OUT [--actor ACTOR]
                              [--requested-at REQUESTED_AT]
                              [--format {text,json}]
                              model rules

Map each printed rule B1, ..., Bn => r(x, y) of a rule miner into one guarded
constraint with an atom consequent (source induced, status proposed, modality
deontic), count its support over the population's distinct head pairs, and
write an evolve proposal only if every rule's count equals the miner's and
every rule holds. Admission is all-or-nothing. Exits 0 when the proposal is
written, 3 on any refusal (a shape outside the mapping, a binding or count
mismatch, a rule that does not hold, invalid input), 5 when the population
fails to load, 11 when --out exists, 64 on a usage error, 66 on a missing
input, 70 on an internal defect, 74 on a refused path.

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model file
  rules                 the miner's printed rule lines (amie)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --population POPULATION
                        the mined population
  --reported REPORTED   the miner run record (gnd-mined-run/1)
  --target {amie}       the miner RULES come from
  --out OUT             write the evolve proposal here
  --actor ACTOR         who requests the proposal (its audit actor_id)
  --requested-at REQUESTED_AT
                        the audit time, ISO-8601 with a UTC offset (default:
                        now); fix it for reproducible output
  --format {text,json}  output rendering: human-readable text (default) or one
                        JSON payload
